purpose: Prove the constitution's terminal product proposition through a finite repeated-natural-task cohort: sustained goal-level delivery, lower user orchestration burden than source-bound ad-hoc baselines, real demand-driven capability and carrier lifecycles, and live cross-host open reference delivery. v0.2 remains an immutable bounded calibration milestone and cannot satisfy this program by inheritance.

increments.observedProblem: Pre-freeze review reproduced a P1 enrollment defect: taskIdentity is accepted as any non-empty string and a frozen cohort protocol may declare any non-empty strata list. The same source task can therefore be relabeled and required O1/O5 scenario coverage can be avoided before task-bound validators or aggregate cohort checks run.
increments.hypothesis: A code-owned natural-task source-digest format, exact six-class scenario enumeration and exact protocol strata realization can remove free-form aliases and scenario invention at registration while leaving source-event recomputation to the future task-specific validator and leaving acceptance thresholds solely in product/acceptance.json.
increments.falsifier: The repair treats a digest-shaped self-report as proof of naturality or behavior, embeds future task sources, changes acceptance thresholds, accepts a noncanonical task identity or scenario, permits a frozen protocol with missing, extra, duplicated or reordered strata, or creates a registry, outcome receipt ecosystem or prebuilt result validator.
increments.stopCondition: Regression tests reject noncanonical task identities, unrecognized scenario classes and flexible protocol strata while accepting exact code-owned forms; existing zero-evidence planning remains valid; the program returns to ready and unfrozen with O1-O5 zero, canonical local and hosted checks pass, and no profile, registration, evidence or temporary residue is created.

deliverables: exact scenario class and protocol strata guards
